title: ALIGNMENT FAKING- the Train→Deploy Asymmetry: Through a Game-Theoretic Lens with Bayesian–Stackelberg Equilibria
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring 'alignment faking' (strategic deception) in LLMs using technical safety and harmlessness benchmarks like HarmBench and BeaverTails. It treats alignment as a technical safety and game-theoretic problem rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious traditions, spiritual beliefs, or formal philosophical ethical systems.
